notes.title: Tetherfall Demo Release
notes.content:
As the solo developer behind FaceSoftware, I’m proud to announce that the Tetherfall demo will release on [u][b]May 30th at 12AM (GMT+1)[/b][/u].

After [b]two years[/b] of solo development, most of Tetherfall’s core features and systems are complete. With the foundation in place, the path toward full release will now move significantly faster.

This demo showcases the first moments of the game — not only to gather feedback, but also to help shape the final vision early on. 

I’m proud of what I’ve built so far. Being a solo dev isn’t always easy — [b]motivation[/b] often defines the outcome of my work. But the more I worked on Tetherfall, the more motivated I became.

I hope you enjoy this experience as much as I loved creating it.

With your feedback, I’m confident the full game will become an unforgettable journey filled with story, hidden lore, and unique mechanics.

From the bottom of my heart, [b]thank you[/b] for helping make this dream real — just by being here and playing.

— José Parente / [b]FaceSoftware[/b]
